A new kingmound may have been found

Old Uppsala (Gamla Uppsala) may have a new kingmound. In an ongoing archaeological dig, researchers made great but unexpected findings.

The finds were made at a digsite that has been made to find the old ärkebiskopsgården [ arch-bishops courtyard], before it was moved to current Uppsala in 1275. The Arch-Bishops courtyard had been found, but it is far from the only thing that was found.

The findings have outdone all our expectations. I have never found so incredibly much in a research. – said John Ljungkvist, archaeologist at Uppsala University, and project leader for the dig.

In addition to the Bishops courtyard they also found what they believe is a new kingsmound. A little next to the church of Gamla Uppsala is a hill, where a small dig was made in 2013. They tried to figure out if the hill was the foundation of a house, but there was an even bigger mound underneath. The big mound could be around 30 meter in diameters, but it has been built upon and “encapsulated” in de Dark Ages.

We will not be ablo to know why they did so, said John Ljungkvist

The mound dates from the 600’s, and is from the same age as the other king mounds. There is utmost a few decennia difference in age. It would be too expensive to dig out the mound, but researchers will dig around it to discover how it was built.

Within will surely be remains that were cremated and a lot of animal bones and a fire, a lot of riches and a full weapon and armor set.

It is a little frustrating to not be able to dig the site, but there just isn’t any money now. We are still very happy with what we have found, said John Ljungkvist.

Besides the kingmound, researchers have also found a Viking-Age farm and smithy. The finds have exceeded their expecations. The Viking-Age houses were right besides the kingmound, and prove that there were a lot of them [houses] around the mounds. Hi, I'm Carl and I have been managing the Closed Beta for The Awakening. As part of the beta process, I will be providing a weekly State of the Beta news post. This is the eighth such post.

Earlier State of the Beta posts: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7

Unique rebalance

As well as adding over 100 unique items and Jewels in The Awakening, we've made balance changes to around 50 unique items. Mark2 outlines the changes in this manifesto post.

Leech Changes

The new leech changes are on the realm. We have worked out we need to change leech rate as it currently works. Currently, when you would already be at the Leech Cap, the rate increase does not give you more leech, as you are already at the cap, while it still reduces the time taken to leech. This can make Leech Rate detrimental to a player in fights against large number of targets, or who otherwise reaches the leech cap quickly.

We will be changing increased Leech Rate to increased Life/Mana Leeched per Second. This will be best against single targets, or in times when you do not reach the Leech Cap, but will not be detrimental in situations you are against a large number of targets.

We are also looking at increasing the values of the Leech Cap. We will then have two main bonuses affecting leech gained, with Leech Cap bonuses best against packs, and Increased Leech Per Second bonuses best against bosses. Neither will be detrimental to the player.

Energy Shield Leech was also bugged on the beta, and was not stacking in the way Life and Mana Leech now are. This will be fixed on the next deploy.

Maps and Map Drops

The next patch will include some changes to map drop rates. The end result of the changes should make it easier to get to and maintain mid to high-tier maps. The highest tiers of maps (level 80 to 82) will still be challenging to reach and maintain.

We are also doing a rework of map mods. Once done it will be patched in. We will make a manifesto post once the details are close to finalised.

Timeframes

Chris posted news yesterday which outlined the general time frames leading up to The Awakening's release.

I am aiming to do a small patch before this week with the unique items, leech, and a few other changes.

After that my focus is on the 1 July patch which completes the content on the beta. As well as finishing off The Awakening, a few team members are getting trailers and other assets ready for the media and marketing push you should start seeing late next week.

How are we tracking?

Number of issues required to be completed for release: 530

Yes, that is a lot more issues than last week. 120 of the issues are new since last week. There are two things that have caused this jump. General issues for things we are getting together now being turned into individual issues. For example, the new challenges and achievements make up dozens of individual issues.

The other cause of the increase is small issues being identified that require a fix.

There are more issues, but they are smaller and being dealt with fast.
